about_the_game:
HYPERQUIZ is a fast-paced, high-quality trivia experience for those who crave a true intellectual challenge.

Jump into a global match to compete against players from around the world, or challenge your friends in private matches to compete for trivia glory.

HYPERQUIZ questions are not computer-generated or user-submitted—they are meticulously hand-written by industry professionals to test the depths of your expertise across a vast range of topics. At launch, our database has 20,000+ questions covering 16 categories.

Every question has a curated bank of acceptable answers, so don't worry about being precise. Prove you know the answer, and you'll get points.

In an era where information is abundant but genuine knowledge is often overlooked, HYPERQUIZ is a stand against intellectual complacency. Humans are getting dumber, and HYPERQUIZ is a call to resist that trend. Sharpen your mind, reclaim your focus, and prove your intellectual mettle.
